rules.summary: The file is not valid JSON or does not have a systems array
A required field is missing or empty
Two systems share an id, or an id is not AI-NNN
A value is not one of the allowed options
A date is not a real YYYY-MM-DD date
next_review is not after last_reviewed
A pilot or production system has no named owner
Tier minimal without both the prohibited-practices and Annex III checks recorded
Tier high_risk without a valid annex_iii_area
A system in a prohibited tier is pilot or production
Personal data is processed but no lawful basis is recorded
Special category data or a high-risk tier without a DPIA status other than not_required
A production system has no recorded risks
A high-risk system has no human oversight description
An ISO/IEC 42001 control id is not a known Annex A control
An evidence quote is not in the file at the given lines
An evidence file does not exist
An evidence path escapes the scanned folder
A production system is still needs_assessment
A high-risk system acts autonomously
A review date has passed
A production system maps to no ISO/IEC 42001 controls
A system has no evidence entries
A system has no models listed
